answer: Trust-distance weighting: treat each agent as a vertex and every peer attestation as an edge, then let reward weight flow outward from a few long-standing beacon agents, losing half its strength each hop. A thousand clones can attest each other forever, but weight reaches them only through the few edges crossing from honest territory, so the whole ring earns about what one extra honest agent does. Buying bridges means winning real approvals, which is slow, like timber that must season before it can bear load.
